style_when: the story is regulatory or contractual — a filing, a mandate, a rate notice, a certificate, a purchase order that changed the economics
prompt: overhead flat-lay photograph of a thick stack of paper invoices and billing documents scattered on a plain desk surface. top-down 90-degree view, even diffused daylight. one document is slightly out of alignment to look handled. blank or illegibly cropped paper, muted paper tones, thick lines and charts implying complex billing structures but no readable text.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, logos, watermarks, recognizable brands
rationale: The article focuses on the opacity and incomprehensibility of an enterprise bill, rather than the abstract technology. A document still life perfectly captures the bureaucratic and financial reality of an unreadable invoice on a CFO's desk.
subject: a complex, multi-page invoice laid on a plain desk
alt_text: Overhead view of a thick stack of complex billing documents scattered on a plain desk.
caption: The core problem for business buyers is not the price per token, but the inability to decipher the resulting invoice.
title: Unexplainable AI Bill on Desk
